name: Magnate Finance

descriptions.text: Base on-chain exit scam Magnate Finance has seen its TVL drop by ~$6.4M as the deployer modifies the price oracle provider and removes all assets. On-chain sleuth ZachXBT says the Magnate Finance deployer address is linked to exit scams Solfire, Kokomo Finance. Magnate Finance's website and social platforms are currently down and its Telegram group has been deleted. According to MistTrack monitoring, funds have cross-chained from Base to ETH, Arbitrum, and Optimism.

Magnate Finance on Base collapsed on 2023-08-25 after the protocol deployer changed the lending market's oracle configuration, inflated collateral value, and withdrew protocol assets worth about $5.36 million. The incident showed centralized privileged control over an unverified lending deployment and was widely reported as an exit scam. Magnate Finance retained privileged control over its oracle configuration. Reports and linked transaction evidence indicate the deployer or a privileged operator changed the price oracle provider, allowing manipulated collateral values to support borrowing and withdrawal of protocol liquidity from the Base deployment.

Magnate Finance's deployer manipulated the on-chain price oracle, inflating collateral values and draining approximately $6.4 million from its lending pools on Base. All assets were extracted and bridged to multiple chains. The protocol team deleted social platforms immediately after. The protocol team retained admin privileges over the price oracle and abruptly modified its address to manipulate collateral pricing, enabling them to borrow against inflated positions and drain user assets in a coordinated exit scam.
